name: Preflight a CRM import and route conflicting duplicates for human review

parameters.content:
## CRM import preflight — no credentials needed
For operations teams reviewing a contact import before any CRM write. Import this JSON and run the manual trigger. All sample records are fictional. No services, keys or personal data are required.

This workflow is a preflight report, not an importer. It makes no network calls and sends no messages. Never connect the outputs directly to outreach.

## Use your own batch
Replace the sample Code node with one item containing batchId (non-empty string), records (array of sourceId, email, company), and existingContacts (array of email, crmId). Supply a current, authorized CRM snapshot. An empty snapshot does not prove there are no existing matches.

Email keys are trimmed and lowercased; company strings are trimmed but case-sensitive. Extra fields are deliberately ignored: add them to normalization and conflict comparison before mapping them. Missing fields and ambiguous matches need human review.

## Expected sample result
10 rows: 2 ready for mapping, 7 human review, 1 identical duplicate skipped. Check all three output nodes. Row 5 maps to an existing sample CRM ID; neither ready row has been written anywhere.

Every member of a conflicting email group is held for review. Reused source IDs are held even when email differs. Structurally malformed batches fail loudly. A group with an invalid row is not partially accepted.

Before adapting: review every exception, decide field ownership, protect logs containing contact data, test a copy against a non-production CRM, and add a durable idempotency mechanism. Re-running this workflow does not provide cross-run write protection.
